families.name: Etched split
families.summary: A full-bleed pair that breaks out of the content column while its copy still lines up with the content edge on both sides. Stacks when the page is narrow. --roomy gives each pane the full section rhythm. Cinch is built on it.
families.markup:
Why it matters

Most systems fail at the seams, not the center

Each tool works on its own. The cost shows up where data crosses from one to the next: re-keyed orders, stale reports, follow-ups nobody owns.

The approach

  • Map every hand-off between systems
  • Fix the model before adding automation
  • Instrument it so problems surface first

themes/brand.css

@layer fh.themes
/* Load after firehorse.css */
@layer fh.themes {
  [data-fh-theme="brand"] {
    --fh-font-sans: "Your Sans", system-ui;
    --fh-font-mono: "Your Mono", ui-monospace;

    /* light canvas, dark canvas */
    --fh-color-accent: light-dark(#1d4ed8, #60a5fa);

    --fh-button-radius: var(--fh-radius-md);
    --fh-card-radius: var(--fh-radius-md);
  }
}
